F.No. Stds/SP(Water & Beverages)/Notif(3)/FSSAI-2016.—Whereas the draft of the Food Safety and
Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Amendment Regulations, 2017, were published as required by
the sub- section (1) of section 92 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (34 of 2006), vide notification of the Food
Safety and Standards Authority of India number F. No. Stds/SP(Water & Beverages)/Notif(3)/FSSAI-2016, dated the
12th October, 2017, in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part III, Section 4, inviting objections and suggestions from
the persons likely to be affected thereby, before the expiry of the period of thirty days from the date on which the copy of
the Official Gazette containing the said notification were made available to the public;
And whereas copies of the said Gazette were made available to the public on the 18th October, 2017;
And whereas objections and suggestions received from the public in respect of the said draft regulations have
been considered by the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (e) of sub-section (2) of section 92 of the said Act,
the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India hereby makes the following regulations further to amend the Food
Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011, namely:-
Regulations
1.
(1) These regulations may be called the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives)
Eighth Amendment Regulations, 2018.
(2) They shall come into force with effect from the date on which they published in the Official Gazette.
2.
In the Food Safety and Standards (Food Products Standards and Food Additives) Regulations, 2011, in regulation
2.10 relating to “Beverages (Other than Dairy and Fruits and Vegetables based)”, in sub-regulation 2.10.7 relating
to “Mineral Water”,-
(a) in clause 2 relating to “Description and types of Mineral Water”, after sub-clause (vi) , the following shall be
inserted, namely: -
‘(vii) Natural Spring Water – Natural spring water is natural mineral water which is derived from an
underground formation from which water flows naturally to the surface of the earth at an identified location.
Spring water shall be collected only at the spring or through a borehole tapping the underground formation
feeding the spring. There shall be a natural force causing the water to flow to the surface through an orifice.
The product shall conform to the standards for mineral water as specified in clause 4 of this sub-regulation,
except Total Dissolved Solids (TDS) content.
“TDS of the product shall be not more than 750 mg/litre".;
(b) for the number and words “2. Treatment and handling”, the number and words “3. Treatment and handling”
shall be substituted;
(c)  for the number and words “3. All Mineral Water shall conform to the following standards”, the number and
words “4. All Mineral Water shall conform to the following standards” shall be substituted.
PAWAN AGARWAL, Chief Executive Officer
